# chelsea hopkins

> chartered pr practitioner and developer in gloucestershire, uk. comms lead at fasthosts (ionos group) by day. builds mobile apps and websites by night, and for clients through hopkins action.

## what i do

- communications: pr, social, crisis comms, ghostwriting. chartered pr practitioner (cipr), mcim.
- app development: mobile apps in expo and react native, shipped to the app store and google play. web apps in next.js and supabase.
- web development: wordpress and woocommerce sites that businesses run on. bookings, memberships, stock control, dealer maps. building on wordpress since 2008.
- product analytics: posthog wired in from day one.

## availability

available for app and web development work through hopkins action: https://hopkinsaction.com/

## things i've built

- whimsee: a location-based app for hiding small notes where you stand. live on ios and android. https://whimsee.co.uk/
- jackdaw: ai social drafting with a human veto. closed beta. https://heyjackdaw.com/
- pressed-hog: a wordpress plugin that wires posthog into wordpress. https://github.com/ookpassant/pressed-hog
- courser-calculator, marshpoint, minimum-viable-exercise and more: https://github.com/ookpassant
